title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
Position:
**Project Quality Engineer (CPS Business Unit)**

Reports to:
**Quality Manager**

Location :
**Manesar**

**Job summary and key objectives :**

The role as Project Quality Engineer coordinates all clients tender and contracts activities within Quality scope.

You shall analyze and consider the demands of the client request for tender and support project members in all topics regarding Quality. You are responsible to develop and ensure implementation of Project Quality Plans as per contract , Camfil standards, rules and regulations as well as potential legal requirements.

The Project Quality Engineer is responsible to provide Sales and the Project Manager with a Quality- documentation, planning, budget, forecast and continuous assessments for a successful client tender and contract delivery.

**Role priorities**

* Coordination and support of Quality work throughout the entire client tender and contract.
* Establish and deliver Project Quality documentation in project scheduled time according to agreed milestones and assure implementation of control measures.
* If necessary, require investigations and actions for Non conformities and risks with lessons learned back to organization.
* Based on needs visit the clients and suppliers to monitor performance and give support. (Installation sites, manufacturing, sub-contractors).
* Forecasts job hours and monitors charges to the project quality budget.
* Within given budget deliver according to the requirements of the contract and Camfil´s processes. Function can also assist with Support and/or lead internal and external Quality audits
* Address gaps and suggest improvements relating to management systems and process compliance also in relation to other functions.

**Requirements**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering.
* Customer focus and collaboration skills
* As a person you are a team player with good communication and people skills
* A few years of experience as part of quality work, preferably in projects and the manufacturing or construction industry.
* English language both oral and written is required, any other language is an advantage
* Good skills in Microsoft Office.

title: UAS Compliance & Documentation Lead
description:
Dronny is looking for a UAS Compliance & Documentation Lead to join our engineering and regulatory team.

We are developing a regulated autonomous drone-delivery platform and are looking for someone who can take ownership of compliance documentation, regulatory evidence, safety assessments and coordination between engineering and aviation-compliance teams.

Key Responsibilities

\* Manage and maintain UAS compliance documentation

\* Support development of SORA 2.5, ConOps and operational-authorisation documentation

\* Maintain compliance matrices, evidence trackers and configuration records

\* Coordinate FMEA, FHA, safety assessments and test evidence

\* Map engineering evidence against applicable EASA OSOs and Means of Compliance

\* Coordinate with engineering teams to close documentation and compliance gaps

\* Support preparation of test plans, test reports and compliance declarations

\* Maintain document version control and traceability

\* Coordinate with external aviation consultants and regulatory stakeholders

\* Track open compliance actions through to closure

Preferred Experience / Knowledge

\* Aviation, UAV/drone, aerospace, automotive safety, defence, quality or regulated engineering background

\* Understanding of risk assessment, FMEA/FHA or safety-management processes

\* Strong technical-documentation skills

\* Experience working with standards, compliance matrices or certification evidence

\* Familiarity with EASA UAS regulations, SORA, OSOs or aviation compliance is highly desirable

\* Strong Excel, Word and documentation-management skills

\* Ability to work closely with hardware, software and operations teams

Who We’re Looking For

Someone who is structured, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-moving engineering startup where regulations, technical development and testing must all remain aligned.

Direct UAS experience is preferred, but candidates from other highly regulated engineering industries with strong compliance and safety-documentation experience are also encouraged to apply.

title: Placement & tech Intern
description:
**Job Description**

**About Newton School of Technology**

Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley.

**Role**

We are looking for a Placement & Tech Intern to support B.Tech CSE students with their technical and placement readiness. You will work on DSA, AI, student engagement, placement operations, and data tracking to help students prepare for successful tech placements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Readiness & Tech Support**

* Support students with DSA and AI-focused preparation.
* Track student progress and identify students needing support.
* Help students prepare for technical assessments and interviews.
* Conduct readiness checks and follow up on preparation activities.

**Placement Operations & Coordination**

* Coordinate placement drives, interviews, schedules, and student applications.
* Maintain placement trackers, dashboards, and student records.
* Coordinate with students, academic teams, and recruiters.

**Student Engagement & Communication**

* Communicate placement updates, opportunities, eligibility, and deadlines.
* Address student queries and coordinate resolutions.
* Conduct student briefings and follow-ups.

**Data & Reporting**

* Track applications, interview stages, offers, and student drop-offs.
* Analyze placement data and identify key trends.
* Maintain reports using Excel and Google Sheets.

**Key Requirements**

* Pursuing/recent B.Tech/B.E in CSE, IT, or related fields.
* Strong programming fundamentals and DSA.
* Good coding and problem-solving skills.
* Interest in AI and technology.
* Good communication and student-handling skills.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets.
* LeetCode/CodeChef/HackerRank experience encouraged.
* Strong ownership, organization, and attention to detail.

**Good to Have**

Power BI/Tableau

GitHub/coding projects

AI/ML exposure

DSA mentoring/technical community experience

**Why Join us**

Work on DSA, AI & technical readiness with CSE & AI students.

Opportunity for full-time conversion after the internship.

Competitive full-time compensation, above market standards.

**Open Positions**

2

**Mandatory Skills**

DSA, Programming, Student Coordination, Placement Operations, Excel, Communication, High Ownership

title: Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive - PED
description:
Autoliv's primary goal is to Save More Lives. Our products never get a second chance. This is why we can never compromise on quality. We are working to increase vehicle safety by developing seatbelts, airbags and steering wheels and you can be part of our team as
 **ROLE** 
 .
   

  

 Autoliv is looking for a dynamic
 **Senior Executive \- PED** 
 to join our team and contribute to manufacturing excellence, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a motivated and technically proficient
 **Advanced Specialist / Senior Executive \- PED** 
 to support productivity improvement initiatives, process optimization, automation projects, and manufacturing excellence programs. The role will involve line balancing, time studies, PLC troubleshooting support, new equipment installation, and the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across the manufacturing environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support production layout optimization and manufacturing efficiency improvements.
* Assist in PLC logic understanding, programming support, and troubleshooting of automation systems.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams to resolve automation\-related issues.
* Participate in New Product Development (NPD) activities and new equipment installations.
* Implement jigs, fixtures, and Poka\-Yoke solutions to enhance process reliability.
* Prepare and maintain process documentation including Work Instructions (WI), SOPs, PFMEA, and Process Flow Charts.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives such as Kaizen, SMED, Lean Manufacturing, and 5S.
* Conduct Time Studies, Line Balancing, Capacity Analysis, and Work Measurement activities.
* Contribute to IoT, automation, and digital manufacturing initiatives.
* Work with AI\-assisted analytics tools for process optimization.
* Support computer vision applications for inspection and defect detection.
* Assist with robotic integration projects.
* Diagnose automation faults using PLC diagnostic tools, error logs, and communication checks.
* Support systems utilizing industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profibus, and Ethernet/IP.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Industrial Engineering tools: Time Study, Method Study, MOST, and Work Measurement.
* Basic to intermediate PLC programming knowledge.
* Understanding of PLC architecture, scan cycles, I/O mapping, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes and layout optimization.
* Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and Poka\-Yoke methodologies.
* Understanding of industrial communication protocols.
* Technical knowledge of machines and automation systems.
* Basic understanding of ladder logic and PLC programming concepts.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint. AutoCAD knowledge is preferred.
* Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts such as classification, prediction, and anomaly detection.


 Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Customer Focus
* Global Perspective
* Innovation Mindset
* Execution Excellence
* Accountability
* Collaboration
* Ability to Engage and Inspire Others
* Trust Building


 Who You Are
   

  

* A strong team player with excellent communication skills.
* An innovative thinker with a passion for continuous improvement.
* A problem solver with strong analytical and documentation capabilities.
* Someone who enjoys working at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, and emerging technologies.


**Preferred Qualification**
* PLC Basics Certification


**We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.**
 In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.
   

  

**More lives saved – more life lived!**
